statement: Two clean physical UI controls stayed stable; two baseline virtual runs replaced the entry on opening Controller list. Baseline AE and 83 replies were byte-identical within each instance. Steam raw release/reopen and native input re-registration bracketed the failure. Two private virtual runs accepting exact named record reads with synthetic empty replies had no observed raw reopen or controller-info failure, and stable lists. Both opened Begin Test; one details transition remained visually unclear. This is consumer evidence supporting the absent-read workaround, not physical validation of synthetic replies or proof of evdev UI identity.

applicability.firmware: Physical feature session build attribute 0x6ACFF323; not re-read in every UI-only control
applicability.scope: Wired named-read metadata and consumer stability only; no pairing material, receiver, Bluetooth, bootloader or setting writes.
